config.source:
SELECT breakdown, category, record_count
FROM (
  SELECT stack(
    10,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Duplicates', duplicate_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Invalid Distance', invalid_distance_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Invalid Rate', invalid_rate_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Missing City', missing_city_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Missing Payment', missing_payment_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Missing Fare', missing_fare_rows,
    'Data Quality Issue', 'Missing Rating', missing_rating_rows,
    'Record Count', 'Bronze Records', bronze_rows,
    'Record Count', 'Clean Records', clean_rows,
    'Record Count', 'Rejected Records', rejected_rows
  ) AS (breakdown, category, record_count)
  FROM ride_hailing_trip_analytics_project.default.gold_data_qualitys
)
